6.182 rsWrongNumberOfChartSeries
rsWrongNumberOfChartSeries is a critical error that will occur when the number of ChartSeries
elements within a ChartSeriesCollection element does not match the number of leaf-node
ChartMember elements within a Chart.ChartSeriesHierarchy, or when the number of
ChartData.ChartSeries does not match the number of SeriesGrouping.StaticSeries for a Chart. (A leaf-
node ChartMember does not contain a child ChartMember.ChartMembers element.)
